note: Written by data/coverage_report.py; do not widen it by hand. This is the ONLY place a coverage category may be written (tests/test_coverage_source.py). It records what the SERVED collection `kanoon_v1` holds, measured 4 Nov 2026: 381,271 Supreme Court points and 74,484 Central Act points, nothing else. High Courts (legal_corpus_v1/v2) and State Acts and regulations (1,024,068 points in the staging collection acts_noncentral_v1, never promoted, A133) are NOT listed: the owner widened scope on 3 Nov 2026, but that is intent and this file records what is held. The change that serves them must add them here (HELD_COURTS, INSTRUMENTS) and regenerate. So the five statutes the Act inventory found absent (CrPC 1973, Consumer Protection 1986, Payment of Gratuity 1972, Employees' Compensation 1923, the Constitution) are NOT held: their text lives only in the staging collection. The Indian Trusts Act 1882 is not in the dataset at all. There is no length exclusion (owner); held does not mean complete (A141 is open). OWNER ITEM, not resolved here: the sentence ends 'anything after the data-as-of date', and the snapshot is labelled v2026.08 while the latest Supreme Court judgment held is dated 6 November 2025 (reported by the SC lane), so the date overstates currency by about nine months.
